{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Italian-American cuisine|Italian-American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]]

==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Turkey|ground turkey]] or [[Cookbook:Ground Beef|beef]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]]
* 1 jar (26 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 730 g) [[Cookbook:Spaghetti Sauce|spaghetti sauce]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Italian Seasoning|Italian seasoning]]
* 1 package (8 oz / 225 g)  [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Cottage Cheese|cottage cheese]]
* ½ cup light [[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]]
* 1 box (16 oz . 500 g) of [[Cookbook:Noodle|spaghetti noodles]]
* ⅛ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Bread Crumbs|bread crumbs]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]] (180°C).
# [[Cookbook:Sauté|Sauté]] ground meat with onion. When cooked through, mix in spaghetti sauce and seasoning.
# Combine cream cheese, cottage cheese, and sour cream; mix well.
# Cook spaghetti noodles according to package directions.
# Spray 3-[[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] with [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|cooking spray]].
# Layer half the spaghetti noodles on the bottom of the dish.
# Spoon cheese mixture on top of noodles.
# Layer remaining noodles on top of cheese mixture.
# Spread meat mixture on top of second noodle layer.
# Mix bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese and sprinkle on top.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] 30 minutes until bubbly and heated through.
